name: Test User 1
text: Huge pool and the kids loved the water slide. Great family resort right on the beach.

name: Test User 2
text: Rooms were clean and the pool area was beautiful. A bit pricey but worth it for the view.

name: Test User 5
text: Very peaceful and secluded beach. We only heard the waves and the birds all afternoon.

name: Test User 6
text: A calm and tranquil spot by the ocean, perfect for a quiet morning walk on the sand.

name: Test User 7
text: Hardly anyone here. Relaxing place to read a book and watch the sunset over the water.

name: Test User 8
text: Loud music and a packed dance floor every weekend. The DJ was great and drinks were cheap.

name: Test User 9
text: Way too crowded and noisy for me, but the nightlife here is clearly popular with students.

name: Test User 10
text: Took the five hour glacier cruise and saw whales, seals and huge chunks of ice falling off.

name: Test User 11
text: Our captain was friendly and the glacier views were amazing. Bring a warm jacket for the boat.

name: Test User 14
text:
